description:
One service's price. What New York area vendors in one category publish as a starting price for a whole event: the median and
the middle half (25th to 75th percentile), from how many vendors and when, optionally for one area, plus
per-hour or per-guest figures where the category is priced that way. Comes with a one-sentence summary
and the page to cite. Use it to answer "how much does a wedding DJ cost in Brooklyn".

area.description: Optional area: NYC (any of the five boroughs), Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, Bronx, Staten Island, Long Island, Westchester, North Jersey or Central Jersey, or New Jersey for both; a county or town also works (Bergen County, Hoboken, Monmouth County). Omit for the whole New York area.
area.title: Area

category.description: Vendor category in plain words: "photographers", "DJ", "caterer", "florist", "planner", "live band", "videographer", "photo booth", "hair and makeup" or "cakes". Other metros also have "party rentals", "AV and lighting", "decor", "food trucks", "entertainers", "officiants", "stationery", "transportation" and trades ("painters", "plumbers", "electricians", "interior designers", "landscapers", "movers"; facts, no score). list_categories gives the full list.
category.title: Category

metro.description: Optional metro: "Chicago" and the other metros list_categories names. Omit for New York. An area naming a metro works too.
metro.title: Metro

name: get_price_summary

area_note.description: Set when the area had too few prices and the whole region is used.
area_note.title: Area Note

cite_as.title: Cite As

sentence.title: Sentence
